sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "locations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "books" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "isbn13" TEXT NULL, "ol_work_key" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "authors" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "title_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "cover_url" TEXT NULL, "cover_local_path" TEXT NULL, "pages" INTEGER NULL, "genre" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "language" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "ownership" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'owned', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'want', "current_page" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rating" INTEGER NULL, "location_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "owner_name" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "started_on" TEXT NULL, "finished_on" TEXT NULL, "series" TEXT NULL, "series_number" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pages IS NULL OR pages > 0), CHECK (current_page >= 0), CHECK (rating IS NULL OR (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)), CHECK (ownership IN ('owned', 'wishlist', 'borrowed')), CHECK (status IN ('want', 'reading', 'finished', 'dropped')));
CREATE INDEX idx_books_isbn13 ON books (isbn13)
CREATE INDEX idx_books_ol_work_key ON books (ol_work_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_books_title_key ON books (title_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_books_location_id ON books (location_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_books_ownership_status ON books (ownership, status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "pages_read" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_page" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_page" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pages_read > 0));
CREATE INDEX idx_reading_logs_book_date ON reading_logs (book_id, date)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quotes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "page" INTEGER NULL, "is_favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favourite" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_quotes_book_id ON quotes (book_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_phone" TEXT NULL, "started_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_on" TEXT NULL, "returned_on" TEXT NULL, "previous_location_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (direction IN ('lent', 'borrowed')));
CREATE INDEX idx_loans_book_id ON loans (book_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_loans_due_open ON loans (due_on) WHERE returned_on IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_loans_one_active_per_book ON loans (book_id) WHERE returned_on IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_books" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (target_books > 0));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_goals_year ON goals (year) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tags_name ON tags (lower(name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_book_tags_pair ON book_tags (book_id, tag_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_locations_name ON locations (lower(name), coalesce(parent_id, '')) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "books_fts" USING fts5(title, subtitle, authors, content = 'books', content_rowid = 'rowid', tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TRIGGER books_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON books WHEN new.deleted_at IS NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO books_fts ("rowid", title, subtitle, authors) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.subtitle, new.authors);END

CREATE TRIGGER books_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON books WHEN old.deleted_at IS NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO books_fts (books_fts, "rowid", title, subtitle, authors) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.subtitle, old.authors);END

CREATE TRIGGER books_fts_au AFTER UPDATE ON books BEGIN INSERT INTO books_fts (books_fts, "rowid", title, subtitle, authors) SELECT 'delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.subtitle, old.authors WHERE old.deleted_at IS NULL;INSERT INTO books_fts ("rowid", title, subtitle, authors) SELECT new."rowid", new.title, new.subtitle, new.authors WHERE new.deleted_at IS NULL;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lookup_cache" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_not_found" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_not_found" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cover_blobs" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (minutes > 0 AND minutes <= 1440));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "read_throughs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "started_on" TEXT NULL, "finished_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
